description: Multi-protocol mDNS/WSD/SSDP reflector for cross-VLAN printer discovery. Adds optional broadcast relay port list for the mdns container.

add.description: Comma-separated UDP broadcast ports relayed between VLAN pairs by the mdns reflector (SNMP/SLP/printer discovery). Leave blank to use the default.

notes: Restart the mdns container after the update. Configure reflector VLAN pairs via Admin → VLAN Config (mDNS option).
